description:
**NovaCare Medical Hub — Health Beyond Limits**, located on **Plot 2A, 2nd Hospital Close, TASO Village, Mbarara City**, is hiring a **Medical Officer** to join its clinical team.

## About the facility

NovaCare Medical Hub is a fast-growing private medical centre in the heart of Mbarara City, built around a diagnostic-led model of care where laboratory results and imaging directly drive every treatment decision. Situated within TASO Village, the hub serves patients from across the greater Mbarara sub-region and western Uganda, handling a steady mix of outpatient consultations, emergency presentations and referred cases from surrounding clinics.

## The role

As Medical Officer, you will run day-to-day clinical care across the outpatient department and emergency unit, working shoulder-to-shoulder with the on-site laboratory and imaging team. This is a role for a doctor who reads the CBC before reaching for the prescription pad — candidates who have practised in lab/imaging-integrated settings will fit right in.

## Key responsibilities

- Provide first-line diagnosis, treatment and stabilisation, including emergency care
- Interpret laboratory and imaging findings to guide patient management plans
- Conduct ward rounds, clerking and follow-up of admitted patients
- Refer complex cases appropriately and maintain accurate medical records
- Support health education for patients and the TASO Village community

## Requirements

- MBChB from a recognized university
- Valid registration/licence with the UMDPC
- Sound clinical skills across emergency care
- Minimum of 3 years of experience
- Prior exposure to diagnostic-led practice (lab/imaging-integrated care) an advantage

## How to apply

Apply by **21 September 2026**:

1. Application letter and updated CV
2. Copies of academic documents and UMDPC licence

Call **0200 970046** or email your application to **health@novacaremedicalhub.com**.

> Note: Never pay money for a job opportunity or recruitment process.
